title: React.js Conf 2016 - Lightning Talks - Elie Rotenberg
summary: A five-minute lightning talk from React.js Conf 2016 by Elie Rotenberg on protecting the DOM from tampering. It shows how React tree obfuscation (react-armor) can shuffle class names, tags and tree structure to defeat CSS-selector-based ad blocking.
why: Cited as the origin of react-armor style DOM obfuscation, and as a favourite short talk from the conference.

quote.text: My favourite talk was only 5 minutes long
